entries.title: In-the-Wild Windows LPE 0-days: Insights & Detection Strategies
entries.description: This article will evaluate detection methods for Windows local privilege escalation techniques based on dynamic behaviors analysis using Elastic Defend features.

entries.title: Unlocking Power Safely: Privilege Escalation via Linux Process Capabilities
entries.description: Organizations need to understand how Linux features contribute to their attack surface via privilege escalation and how to effectively monitor intrusion attempts using free and open detection capabilities.

entries.title: Unveiling malware behavior trends
entries.description: An analysis of a diverse dataset of Windows malware extracted from more than 100,000 samples revealing insights into the most prevalent tactics, techniques, and procedures.

entries.title: Sinking macOS Pirate Ships with Elastic Behavior Detections
entries.description: This research looks at a recently found macOS malware campaign using the macOS Endpoint Security Framework paired with the Elastic Agent to hunt and detect the behaviors this malware exhibits.
